claim.why_it_matters: Demoted to bold text, while its siblings 2.3.1 Function, 2.3.2 General Format and 2.3.3 Syntax Rules (page 585) are '####' headings; a heading-based index misses the Report Writer file control entry general rules.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page XIII-4 (PDF page 586) sets '2.3.4 General Rules' as a numbered section heading in the same bold style as 2.3.1-2.3.3 on page XIII-3. The transcription of page 585 renders 2.3.1 Function, 2.3.2 General Format and 2.3.3 Syntax Rules as '####' headings, but page 586 renders 2.3.4 as the bold paragraph '**2.3.4 General Rules**'. The text itself is present and quoted correctly, so the normative content does not change. The defect is in the document structure: a heading-based index or section extractor would not find the Report Writer file control entry General Rules. The claim is accurate as a structural heading-level defect.
